answer: A proof-of-sustained-work gate: every identity must continuously prove real compute on useful, unpredictable tasks to keep its economic weight, with a summit score that only climbs after weeks of verified work. A lagoon of idle accounts earns nothing, because weight decays the moment work stops. A zephyr of fresh fakes therefore faces full compute cost per identity, every epoch, and a detected farm loses all accumulated weight at once instead of just one account.
